title: The Schatten norm conjecture for r-partite graphs
statement:
Let $p>2$, $n\geq r\geq2$, and let $G$ be an $r$-partite graph of order $n$. Let $T_r(n)$ be the Turán graph on $n$ vertices.

**Schatten norm conjecture for r-partite graphs.** If $G$ is an $r$-partite graph of order $n$, then

$$
\|G\|_p<\|T_r(n)\|_p,
$$

unless $G=T_r(n)$.

The analogous assertion is stated as an elementary extremal result for $p=2$. For $p>2$, the paper presents this strict Turán extremality statement as plausible, while the preceding constructions provide lower-bound evidence relevant to the problem.
source_name: Vladimir Nikiforov, “Beyond graph energy: norms of graphs and matrices”, arXiv:1510.02850 (2016).
references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2007–2015). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1201.5232](https://arxiv.org/abs/1201.5232), [arXiv:math/0702186](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0702186).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1510.02850

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2015).
